intro.title: Theme Context
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Vue app that allows users to toggle between light and dark themes. You will learn how to use Vue's provide/inject API to create a theme context, which shares state across multiple components without passing props manually. The main technologies involved are Vue 3's Composition API, reactive state, and component communication patterns. By the end, you'll understand how to manage global UI state efficiently in a Vue application.
intro.usecase: Theme Context is a foundational pattern for managing consistent UI theming across entire applications. In real-world software, this is essential for implementing user-selectable light/dark modes in dashboards, admin panels, or productivity tools, where a single theme setting must propagate to all components like sidebars, cards, and modals. Developers use this to centralize theme logic—such as colors, fonts, and spacing—ensuring a cohesive look without manually passing props through every component layer. This pattern also supports dynamic theme switching, allowing users to personalize interfaces in applications like design tools or content management systems.
